newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds start slow, soymeal firmer.
newsitem.headline: European feeds start slow, soymeal firmer.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market started the week quietly with sellers offering South American soymeal pellets as much as $5 up following Friday's stronger Chicago soymeal futures close, market sources said.
Most other products were quoted unchanged to slightly easier on the back of a strong dollar. No trades were reported during the early stages of the market.
"Mondays usually are slow. The strong dollar and seller prices kept most buyers sidelined this morning, there was little buying interest reported," one broker said.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
